title: CERTIFY-ED: certificates for exact-diagonalization results

creators.name: Goel, Ritu
creators.affiliation: Vivekananda Institute of Professional Studies - Technical Campus, Delhi

description: Certificates for exact-diagonalization results: rigorous eigenvalue enclosures, completeness counts, eigenspace and label statements, an exact re-check layer without floating-point assumptions, whole-spectrum enclosure by symmetry sectors (formerly symveig), and applications to published rigorous bounds (pyrochlore crown cluster, AKLT spectral-gap criteria).
